features.name: CI workflow rationalization
features.notes: Completed pruning and simplification work, then reopened on 2026-04-14 to remove the redundant merged-branch cleanup workflow, collapse CI into one merge gate, switch agent-ready linked-PR detection from failing GraphQL to REST timeline reads, repair the fmt/clippy drift that was leaving master red after PR #1600, restore the missing pull_request_target closed trigger for post-merge cleanup, guard self-hosted CI lanes from fork PR execution, and finish the Windows self-hosted Rust bootstrap repair and branch/PR audit backfill tracked through issues #2201 and #2196.

features.name: M10 Economy execution scope
acceptance_tests: Roadmap-facing docs route provider-backed Soul/LLM work to M11 and economy execution loops to M10
features.notes: Loot intake, vendor cycle, banking cycle, and economy TUI summaries. Soul/LLM work routed to M11.

features.name: Issue #824 auto-loot sorting and inventory management
features.notes: PARTIAL: Added a core auto-loot inventory management planning scaffold for deterministic post-loot sorting, cursor handling, and equipment-set presence checks. Full rule UI, live inventory integration, swapping, and scenario integration tests remain follow-up work.

features.name: TextQuest no-run compile repair
features.notes: Session compile-repair pass reduced `cargo test -p textquest --no-run` errors from 167 to 0 and restored missing orchestrator/config/runtime surfaces needed for test compilation.

features.name: textquest-admin backup commands
features.notes: Blocked on missing prerequisite work from issues #1729 and #1730. This branch has no `textquest-admin` binary, no `textquest/src/admin/` module, and no admin backup API/client/models to wire. Issue #1733 is marked `agent:ready`, but the required scaffolding is not present in `origin/master` or this worktree.

features.name: Issue #1003 Lua 5.4 dependency setup
features.notes: Centralized the `mlua` version in the workspace manifest and kept `textquest` on Lua 5.4 with vendored Lua enabled so macOS and Windows builds do not depend on a preinstalled Lua runtime.

features.name: Issue #791 Lua 5.4 scripting engine integration
features.notes: Wired the existing Lua runtime into the textquest crate, exposed the issue #791 top-level API shape, and kept this partial because live game-state/DLL-backed APIs remain stubbed.

features.name: Issue #820 Lua scripting support OpenVanilla parity
features.notes: PARTIAL: Extended the existing mlua scaffold with injected player snapshots, drainable navigation and slash-command request queues, real Lua event callback registration/emission, and current API docs/example. Live process-state producers, orchestrator/DLL IPC draining, LuaJIT compatibility, and full OpenVanilla API parity remain follow-up work.

features.name: Issue #958 EQ Binary Diff TUI patch-day reconciliation panel
features.notes: Implemented the Debug screen patch reconciliation panel, filter state, fixture-backed render coverage, and eqdiff patch-report.json output. Full cargo check is currently blocked by unrelated pre-existing textquest errors in loot/smartloot.rs and lua/bindings.rs; cargo check -p eqdiff passes.

features.name: stack spoof invalid module name handling
features.notes: Rejected interior-NUL module names in `stack_spoof::find_gadgets` so `GetModuleHandleA` cannot silently resolve the calling module, added regression coverage, and documented that frame rewriting still operates on the live RBP chain heuristically rather than validating each original return address against a target module.

features.name: M11 zone awareness behavior constraints and mood effects
features.notes: Add TOML-backed zone metadata, neutral fallback for unknown zones, coordinator-time zone loading, and zone-aware idle weighting for behavior and mood interactions.

features.name: Enhanced charm/pet management
features.notes: Partial scaffold: combat charm manager tracks charmed and summoned pets, supports charm recast threshold decisions, candidate affinity selection, and first pet follow command. Remaining work includes real spell-slot selection, charm-break conditions, full pet focus/aggression commands, Lua API bindings, and operator configuration loading.

features.name: Issue #792 MacroQuest plugin loader and compatibility layer
features.notes: Initial scaffold adds MQ2 plugin discovery, per-plugin config defaults, a C-compatible TextQuest MQ2 host API table, an MQ2Bridge command trait implementation, and Windows-only DLL lifecycle loading hooks. Full binary API coverage, true native crash isolation, packet/datatype exports, and popular plugin validation remain follow-up work.

features.name: Clickies module consumable/item automation
features.notes: PARTIAL: Added per-character ownership, enable/disable toggles, and combat/downtime scenario gating to the existing clickies manager. Remaining work includes live inventory detection and the in-game window surface.

features.name: In-game hotkey system for scripts/plugins
features.notes: Partial DLL-side scaffold: global script/plugin slash-command registration and dispatch, built-in /textquest command listing, EQ-style hotkey parsing, command hotkey binding, and TOML persistence helpers. Lua/MQ2/runtime EQ UI hook integration remains follow-up work.

features.name: Issue #990 hotkey and slash command registration system
features.notes: PARTIAL: Extended the orchestrator-side registry with checked hotkey/slash-command registration, Ctrl/Alt/Shift hotkey parsing, per-character scopes, enable/disable controls, command help metadata, required-argument validation, TOML persistence/validation, and Orchestrator-owned shared registries. DLL keyboard hooks and live IPC back-routing remain follow-up work.

features.name: Issue #836 advanced group management and targeting
features.notes: PARTIAL: Added shared auto-group awareness reporting for configured roles, raid-wide online/grouped/missing aggregation, formation suggestions, and role-based targeting priority ordering. The TUI group rows now include class-derived role markers. Remaining work includes live buff/debuff aggregation, persistent group history, raid-wide UI panels, and role-based spell targeting execution.

features.name: Issue #975 performance monitoring dashboard
features.notes: PARTIAL: Added a metrics-side performance dashboard snapshot API with combat, movement, loot, system placeholder, tab metadata, and simple alert aggregation. Full TUI rendering, SQLite history, live system telemetry producers, and richer anomaly detection remain follow-up work.

features.name: Issue #983 web dashboard group and camp configuration UI
features.notes: PARTIAL: Extended the existing web Groups page with form-first group CRUD, role assignment labels, keyboard member reordering, collapsible per-class settings, /api/camps hook integration, saveable camp zone/pull point/combat threshold/template fields, validation, and configuration preview. Remaining work includes full backend persistence validation, richer drag-and-drop between unassigned character pools, template library management, and browser QA against live API data.

features.name: Plugin system for extensibility
features.notes: Partial first-pass plugin scaffold: shared plugin trait, lifecycle registry, domain capability API, non-core inventory example crate, mkplugin scaffold script, and wiki design/API documentation. Dynamic dylib discovery and runtime host wiring remain follow-up work.

features.name: Sub: Core Plugin API Surface (#819-3)
features.notes: Exposed core Lua plugin domains for combat, navigation, and state plus IPC, config, event, and logging integration points with runtime-backed tables and request queues. Added request metadata for IPC target box routing and docs/example coverage with error-handling pattern.

features.name: Issue #822 EQBC-style inter-character communication
features.notes: PARTIAL: Added shared EQBC-line parsing/serialization, native relay event variants for tell/channel forwarding, relay-side auto-detection for legacy EQBC-line peers, and protocol documentation. Full OpenVanilla/MQ2EQBC handshake compatibility, DLL chat-hook publishing, and external tool validation remain follow-up work.

features.name: Issue #838 raid and multi-group coordination
features.notes: PARTIAL: Added shared raid-wide member aggregation, deterministic group/camp snapshots, derived member-down and group-wipe events, command relay planning, and orchestrator snapshot wiring. Remaining work includes live distributed command dispatch, persisted raid event bus consumers, operator formation controls, and validation against 2+ live camps / 8+ characters.
